auto_start.description: Whether to automatically start osdlyrics upon desktop session login.

language.description: The ISO 639 language code for lyrics display and UI.

player.description: The backend player plugin to use (e.g., mpd, rhythmbox, spotify, vlc).

mpd_host.description: Hostname of the MPD server. Only used if player is 'mpd'.

mpd_port.description: Port number of the MPD server. Only used if player is 'mpd'.

lyrics_source.description: The plugin used to fetch lyrics from the internet (e.g., lyricwiki, genius, mosh, wikipedia).

auto_download.description: Automatically search for and download lyrics when a new track starts.

font.description: Pango font string for displaying lyrics.

color_active.description: Color for the currently active lyric line.

opacity.description: Opacity of the lyrics window, from 0.0 (transparent) to 1.0 (opaque).
